title: Seikika assessment
description: One agent's (or person's) judgement of one entity against one rubric (docs/design/scorecards-for-scorecards.md §6). Written as a file in the portal's assessments/ directory or pushed to a server; read by scorecards as records. Stale when subjectHash no longer matches the entity.

subjectHash.description: The entity's subject field (the rubric's `subject`, default `hash`) when it was assessed, as `seikika assess brief` prints it.

name.description: The agent harness or the person, e.g. claude-code.

onBehalfOf.description: Who asked for the assessment, e.g. user:alice.

suggestion.description: For fail or unsure: the change that would make it pass.
